services.title: Residential Roofing
services.short_description: Shingle, metal and rubber roofing for homes across Northeast Pennsylvania, installed by MNM's own crews.
services.long_description: Shingle roofing fortified by Owens Corning warranties, energy-efficient metal systems, and rubber membrane for flat and low-slope sections. Every residential replacement carries a 10-year workmanship warranty plus MNM's 15-year craftsman warranty.

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short_description: Flat, metal and rolled roofing systems for NEPA businesses, with no subcontracting.
services.long_description: Durable shingle and metal roofing systems, commercial rolled roofing for industrial and flat-roofed buildings, and seamless gutters sized for higher water volume. Every project is handled by MNM's in-house crew and backed by the 15-year craftsman warranty.

services.title: Metal Roofing
services.short_description: Standing seam, corrugated, agricultural panel and Tilcor stone-coated steel systems.
services.long_description: MNM installs and supplies Master Rib, 1-1/4" and 2-1/2" corrugated, 5V, PBR, IR, R-Panel and ValuRib panels for residential, commercial, post-frame and agricultural buildings — plus Tilcor stone-coated steel, backed by a 50-year manufacturer warranty.

services.title: Roof Repair & Storm Damage
services.short_description: Emergency repairs, tarping and full insurance claim documentation after NEPA storms.
services.long_description: MNM assesses the full extent of storm damage — including hidden leaks and structural weakness — and provides the detailed report insurers require. Tarping during the storm, prompt repairs after it, and direct work with your adjuster so you are not chasing the claim.

services.title: Gutter Installation
services.short_description: Seamless residential and commercial gutters, downspouts and leaf guards.
services.long_description: Gutters sized to your roof's pitch, area and the local climate — aluminium for low maintenance, copper where the look matters. Sign up for a full roof and gutters and MNM includes leaf guards free.

team_members.name: Miguel Cornejo
team_members.bio: Founded MNM Roofing in Nanticoke in 2018 after years subcontracting for large regional roofing companies. Personally oversees every free estimate and trains every installer on the crew.

faqs.q: How can I get a free estimate for a roof replacement?
faqs.a: You can request a free, no-obligation estimate via the website or by calling the office. The owner personally oversees each estimate to ensure accuracy and clarity.

faqs.q: What warranty do you offer on full re-roof installations?
faqs.a: All full roof replacements come with a 10-year workmanship warranty, plus the 15-year craftsman warranty from the in-house team — covering labor and workmanship.

faqs.q: Do you install gutters as part of a roofing job?
faqs.a: Yes — in addition to roofing, MNM offers full gutter and downspout installations or repairs to protect your home's drainage system.

faqs.q: Are you licensed and insured in Pennsylvania?
faqs.a: Yes. MNM Roofing is fully licensed, bonded, and insured in Pennsylvania (PA154140).

faqs.q: Do you offer discounts or special pricing for seniors or military?
faqs.a: Yes. Discounts are available for senior citizens and military personnel — mention it when scheduling your estimate.

faqs.q: How do you handle storm damage repairs or emergency leaks?
faqs.a: MNM offers prompt roof repair for storm or wind damage, responds quickly, and guides you through the insurance claim process.

faqs.q: What areas do you serve around the Poconos?
faqs.a: All of Northeast Pennsylvania from three locations: Greentown (Poconos — Pike, Wayne, Monroe, Lackawanna), Nanticoke (Luzerne County), and Whitehall Township (Lehigh Valley).
